entries.promotion_gate: Select for advisory review evaluation; only create a custom fork if repository-owned changes are justified.
Select for isolated browser smoke through Web Adapter Foundry; custom fork only if local adapter changes are required.
Map event semantics and failure behavior to the canonical event schema before protocol adoption.
Verify exact open-source package and license scope; benchmark headless artifact needs before adoption.

transition_policy.selected_without_fork: Record the package/API/adapter and immutable version in its owning integration manifest; do not create a submodule.
transition_policy.fork_required: Add a matching entry to the canonical sMods registry with an explicit planned path and fork URL; do not claim a gitlink or pinned SHA yet.
transition_policy.pinned: Require an existing user-owned fork, immutable 40-character commit SHA, exact .gitmodules URL, 160000 gitlink, license/provenance review, and passing dual-gate evidence.
